title: Credit model outside calibration population
input: A credit-risk model is calibrated on individual applicants in one country. It emits 0.87 for a small business in another country. No cross-domain calibration evidence is supplied. Choose the warranted interpretation.

option_menu.A: This is a calibrated 87% probability for the business.
option_menu.B: The model output proves the business has the predicted risk state.
option_menu.C: Treat 0.87 as an out-of-scope score until calibration for this population and domain is established.
option_menu.D: The correct probability must be zero because the domain changed.
